description: Lesson i1 mistake: hal-blink with __HAL_RCC_GPIOA_CLK_ENABLE() forgotten - PA5 never becomes an output, only PC13 blinks
expect: 72 MHz, like hal-blink, but RCC_APB2ENR.IOPAEN is never set: every GPIOA register access is ignored (gated clock, reads 0; the simulator logs it), so PA5 stays in its reset state (input floating) and an LED on PA5 stays dark. GPIOC is clocked: PC13 (on-board LED, active low) is a push-pull square wave, 501 ms high / 501 ms low (HAL_Delay(500) waits 501 ticks).

scenarios.name: PA5 is never driven while PC13 keeps blinking
